name: smartcart
description: SmartCart: 10-minute delivery, scheduled pickup and scan-and-go in-store shopping, with store operations and admin consoles.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @smartcart/api" "npm run dev -w @smartcart/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @smartcart/api && npm run build -w @smartcart/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @smartcart/shared && npm run test -w @smartcart/api
